problem: Lack of automated toll fare aggregation via Fastag API and dynamic fuel cost splitting based on passenger mileage within the VoyPlan budget system.
root_cause: Absence of backend service integrations for real-time fuel price updates and Fastag toll plaza fare calculation, along with corresponding frontend UI components in the mobile budget screen.
architecture: The feature integrates a backend Node.js microservice (`budgetService.js`) powered by an external fuel price provider (`fuelPriceProvider.js`) to pull live rates and calculate distance-based fuel consumption. It interfaces with the Fastag API for toll aggregation, while exposing endpoints consumed by the Flutter frontend (`budget_screen.dart`) to render dynamic splits across passengers.
recommended_solution: Implement `fuelPriceProvider.js` to fetch current fuel rates, update `budgetService.js` to compute precise distance-based fuel splits and aggregate Fastag toll fares, and update `budget_screen.dart` to display the detailed breakdown and passenger cost shares.
risks: Fastag API rate limits or downtime affecting toll fare calculations.
Discrepancies in vehicle mileage specifications leading to inaccurate fuel cost splits.
Network latency issues on mobile devices when fetching real-time budget updates.
acceptance_criteria: Backend successfully fetches live fuel prices via `fuelPriceProvider.js`.
Toll plaza fares are accurately calculated and aggregated using the Fastag API integration.
Fuel costs are correctly split among passengers based on vehicle mileage and trip distance.
Frontend `budget_screen.dart` displays the breakdown of toll fees and individual passenger shares clearly.

test_cases.name: test_fuel_price_provider_fetch
test_cases.description: Verify that `fuelPriceProvider.js` correctly retrieves current fuel prices from the target data source.

test_cases.name: test_budget_service_split_calculation
test_cases.description: Validate that `budgetService.js` accurately computes total fuel consumption, incorporates toll fares from Fastag, and splits costs proportionally among passengers.

test_cases.name: test_budget_screen_ui_rendering
test_cases.description: Ensure `budget_screen.dart` correctly displays the toll aggregate and individual passenger cost splits without layout overflows.
